name: generate_audio
description: Generate spoken audio from text: voiceovers, narration, messages, and reusable speech recordings. Supports ElevenLabs, OpenAI, xAI, Qwen3-TTS and Kokoro. Use for 'create an audio file', 'generate a voiceover', 'read this into an MP3', or 'make ElevenLabs audio with this voice ID'. This creates an audio artifact; it does not change Jarvis's speaking voice or automatically play audio. Use the configured AUDIO_TOOL_PROVIDER unless the user requests a provider. Accept an exact provider-specific voice ID/name; use audio_voices to look up names, exact IDs, previews and delivery capabilities; never invent voice IDs. Preserve supplied text exactly. When writing an unspecified script, prefer about 30 seconds; longer supplied text is allowed within provider character limits. Supports native speech tags for ElevenLabs v3/v4 and xAI. Use audio_voices delivery_capabilities to check syntax for the provider/model; OpenAI mini-TTS uses separate instructions instead. Preserve inline cues in the script. Saves audio and the original script to Stash. For HeyGen avatars, pass the returned audio stash_ref as audio_source and omit script/voice_id; HeyGen voice IDs are different from ElevenLabs IDs. HeyGen's 30-second input limit does not limit this audio tool. For songs/music use generate_music; for audio-to-text use transcribe_audio. No caching, automatic paid retries, provider fallback, or background execution.

text.description: Exact text to speak. Preserve the user's supplied script verbatim. Longer recordings are allowed within provider limits; no automatic truncation or splitting. Native delivery cues are supported for ElevenLabs v3/v4 (e.g. [whispering]) and xAI (e.g. [pause], <whisper>text</whisper>); check audio_voices capabilities before adding cues. Unsupported known cues are rejected before submission.

provider.description: Optional provider for this request when the user specifically asks. Otherwise omit to use AUDIO_TOOL_PROVIDER. Never switch providers to recover a failed paid request.

voice.description: Optional exact voice ID/name for the selected provider. Use audio_voices to resolve a requested name or discover choices, unless the user supplied an exact ID. Overrides only this recording. Omit for the tool/provider ENV default; IDs are not portable across providers.

model.description: Optional exact supported speech model for the selected provider. Omit to use the tool/provider ENV default. Model IDs are not portable across providers.

title.description: Optional short label for the saved recording; not spoken.

instructions.description: Optional delivery direction separate from spoken text, e.g. warm and calm. Supported only by OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts models. Other providers/models reject this argument; use their native tags where supported. Not spoken or shared with Jarvis reply playback.

availability.setup_hint: Set AUDIO_TOOL_PROVIDER and its existing speech credentials/server URL in the selected mode ENV. Optional AUDIO_TOOL_VOICE and AUDIO_TOOL_MODEL override that provider's defaults.
